about_short_description.short_description: swftbox is a shipping platform that offers retailers same-day deliveries through its courier network.

product.name: Same Day Delivery
product.description: Orders placed by 10AM are picked up and delivered the same day by 10pm across the UAE.

product.name: Next Day Delivery
product.description: Orders placed by 10AM are picked up and delivered the next day by 10pm across the UAE.

product.name: Bullet Delivery
product.description: Get your packages delivered within 2-4 hours in Dubai.

product.name: International Delivery
product.description: Deliveries across the GCC, Europe, Asia, and North America in 3-5 days.

product.name: Payment on Delivery (COD)
product.description: Accepts various payment methods including cash, card, and contactless options on delivery.

product.name: Returns Management
product.description: Facilitates easy returns with notifications and no extra charges, similar to delivery fees.
